title: Create visual fixture gallery and integration suite
description:
## Objective
Make graphic quality and contract behavior reviewable.

## Scope
- Fairy-tale title/callout fixture
- Repository code, architecture, flow, and comparison fixture
- 1080p contact sheet and pixel diffs
- Composer integration sample
- Font/license manifest

## Boundaries and risks
- Preserve canonical workspace and contract ownership boundaries.
- Add deterministic tests for failure paths, cancellation, and restart where applicable.
- Do not hide a material downgrade or destructive migration behind a fallback.
design: Phase: release. Implement behind typed ports and versioned contracts. Keep diagnostics machine-readable and user-actionable. Update module documentation and fixtures together with behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] One command regenerates gallery and reports intentional diffs
- [ ] Every fixture passes contrast, bounds, decode, and contract checks
- [ ] Gallery includes failure diagnostics, not only happy paths
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover success and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Public contract and operator/contributor documentation are updated.

title: Deliver deterministic technical and editorial graphics
description:
## Objective
Render exact code, diagrams, charts, titles, and callouts locally so text-critical frames never depend on generative-image typography.

## Delivery boundary
Complete all child beads to produce the module's MVP release. Cross-module integration uses released contracts and fakes before depending on live paid or hardware services.

## Planning rule
Child dependencies encode implementation order. A child is complete only when its acceptance criteria and tests are satisfied, not when code merely exists.
design: Inputs are typed scene primitives. Repository content is escaped data; arbitrary HTML, scripts, and source execution are out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are closed; module README and generated/operator documentation match behavior; clean checkout passes build, test, lint, contract, and release checks; no known P0/P1 defect remains.

title: Harden untrusted content handling and resource bounds
description:
## Objective
Prevent repository text from becoming executable markup or a denial of service.

## Scope
- Strict schema and escaping
- No external entities, remote fonts, script, foreignObject, or arbitrary CSS
- Node/character/image count limits
- Allowed-root image resolution
- Timeout and memory safeguards

## Boundaries and risks
- Preserve canonical workspace and contract ownership boundaries.
- Add deterministic tests for failure paths, cancellation, and restart where applicable.
- Do not hide a material downgrade or destructive migration behind a fallback.
design: Phase: security. Implement behind typed ports and versioned contracts. Keep diagnostics machine-readable and user-actionable. Update module documentation and fixtures together with behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Injection corpus renders as inert text or is rejected
- [ ] Traversal and remote URL tests fail closed
- [ ] Fuzz test does not crash process or write outside attempt path
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover success and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Public contract and operator/contributor documentation are updated.
